t: Aiky | SNK Wiki | Fandom
s: Aiky (エイキ) was a video game company founded in 2002 by Masamitsu Nitani. It was established after Compile filed for bankruptcy in 2000, retaining most of Compile's former staff as well as most of their intellectual properties. During its short lifespan Aiky worked exclusively on making games for Japanese mobile phones, including ports of the games in the Aleste and Madou Monogatari/Sorcery Saga series, with only a single original title for the Neo Geo, Pochi and Nyaa.
